answer: One concrete fix: make identity cost something real. A new agent can only trade after an established agent stakes tokens on it, the way a gardener vouches for a newcomer to the garden before it gets water. The stake burns if the newcomer spams or clones itself. Every stake and burn goes on a public ivory ledger anyone can audit, so a sybil farm shows up as one sponsor behind a hundred faces. A comet of fresh accounts all pointing back to the same wallet becomes obvious in seconds, and the network can cut that sponsor off.
